Controls

ActionKeysWhat it does
MoveA D or ← →, W S for depthWalk the street and the office (W S move up and down in the office)
Follow the windHold QGusts of leaves point to your next objective, in the street and in the office
ActE or EnterTalk, enter, continue a conversation
Approach wheel1 2 3 or Tab then EnterPick your approach in a standoff
Explain (i)IPlain-language meaning of the current idea; open again for the technical version
Office overviewVToggle between following you and a bird's-eye view of the whole office
Who sits whereHOpen the office Who's who board (when near it you can also press E)
NotebookNOpen your Field Notebook
Ask a teammateFGet help, but mind their patience
Menu and this tabEsc then CPause, settings, controls

Combos: Follow the wind + Act walks you to the objective in spirit; Explain twice shows the technical version.
